items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: So we had -- added a little girl singer, Nancy Flake.

ctx.x: So now they got me a job at the Syracuse Hotel. So we had -- added a little girl singer, Nancy Flake. And the boys -- we didn't keep the boy, we kept the girl. So, Slats Long -- his wife worked the Roxie, so he wanted to stay in town, so he said he'd go up till I found somebody. Now we opened, we were a big hit in Syracuse, it was a wonderful thing. Was a great room and the band sounded good, it was soft --
